summary: Make apex-path-only routing a non-optional force-execution rule across source, runtime, CORS, deployment routes and database references.
ownerInstruction: EKODI-owned services must use ekodi.kr paths only. Do not preserve redirects, compatibility aliases, dedicated runtime API hosts or child-host references; detect, replace, verify and block regression.
approvalBasis: Explicit platform-owner instruction in the 2026-09-27 continuation task to establish this as an EKODI force-execution rule and finish correction.
migrationPolicy: Enforce zero EKODI-owned child-host references in GitHub and zero live database references in Supabase, with CI and database health verification.
rollback: Git revert may restore implementation changes, but restoring any EKODI-owned child host requires a new explicit C3 owner approval.
